trends.name: Iran-US Ceasefire Negotiations & Regional Conflict
trends.summary: US, Iran, and regional mediators discussing potential 45-day ceasefire as 'last-ditch effort' to prevent massive strikes. IDF striking Hezbollah infrastructure in Beirut signals escalation risks. Trump issuing ultimatums while negotiations continue, creating extreme market uncertainty.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Market Volatility
trends.summary: Oil crossing $115/barrel amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions and Iran conflict escalation. Saudi Aramco raising crude premiums to record levels. Models show sustained high prices could push US CPI to 3.7% within 7 weeks (highest since Sept 2023). Direct inflation and Fed policy implications.

trends.name: Strait of Hormuz Energy Supply Risk
trends.summary: First Qatari LNG tankers (Rasheeda, Al Daayen) approaching Strait of Hormuz since conflict began, signaling potential supply route normalization but extreme vulnerability. Regional disruptions creating commodity volatility and supply chain uncertainty for global energy markets.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk & Corporate Earnings Impact
trends.summary: S&P 500 10-K analysis reveals massive geopolitical risk mentions: Morgan Stanley 221 references, Citigroup 269. Jamie Dimon cites geopolitical risks as major 2026 concern in annual letter. Tariffs, war, sanctions, and supply chain disruptions dominating corporate risk disclosures.

trends.name: Global Oil Supply Concerns & Peak Oil Debate
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs analyzing whether world is running out of oil amid conflict-driven supply disruptions and Indian pivot to Iran for energy. Peak oil concerns resurfacing in tandem with Middle East instability. Long-term energy security implications for markets.

trends.name: AI Data Center Boom & Insurance Sector Stress
trends.summary: AI data center expansion 'stress-testing' insurers as private capital floods sector. Massive infrastructure buildout creating new insurance and liability exposure. Intel positioned to benefit from helium crisis in geopolitical conflict. Emerging risk and opportunity in AI infrastructure buildout.

trends.name: Mega IPO Pipeline: SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI
trends.summary: Mega IPOs of SpaceX, Anthropic, and OpenAI alone cannot fix structural stock market issues. Recent OpenAI leadership change (Fidji Simo medical leave) adding uncertainty. Market skepticism about whether mega tech IPOs can drive sustained equity rally.

trends.name: US Fiscal Deficit & Inflation Trajectory
trends.summary: Fiscal deficits surging from 3% historically to 6-8% range under Biden/Trump. Bush $150B→$400B, Obama $1.1T→$400B, Trump-Biden $1.4T→$3T. Combined with multipolar geopolitical shift away from 'just-in-time' supply chains, structural inflation pressures mounting. Powell's 'transitory' narrative discredited.

trends.name: Healthcare System Dislocation: Medicare Advantage & Cancer Care
trends.summary: Major hospitals refusing Medicare Advantage plans for cancer patients, creating systemic healthcare market failure. Described as 'overlooked catastrophe' with insurance, hospital, and patient implications. Emerging regulatory/legislative risk in healthcare sector.

trends.name: Banking Sector Valuations & BDC Market Stress
trends.summary: BDC NAVs under pressure from public credit markets weakness. Goldman Sachs BDC and sector facing headwinds. Citigroup positioned as attractive ahead of 2026 Investor Day despite sector headwinds. Credit market deterioration impacting leveraged lending and private markets.

trends.name: State-Level AI & Data Center Restrictions
trends.summary: Maine becoming first US state to ban new data centers with construction freeze until late 2027. 10+ states following suit, creating regulatory headwind for AI infrastructure expansion. Threatens mega AI capex plans and energy security strategies.

trends.name: Tesla South Korea Surge & EV Market Momentum
trends.summary: Tesla South Korea car registrations up 330% YoY to 11,134 vehicles in March. Strong EV adoption momentum in key Asian market. Signals demand resilience and competitive positioning ahead of potential tariff/trade policy changes.
